deposits.notes: The Data Availability Statement directs readers to the article (p. 28). The public publisher PDF was downloaded with urllib into memory, returned HTTP 200, and exactly matches the saved 31-page PDF (SHA-256 876b35c325e6ded29f5d18e518858104ef4bcb2c49d3985f00784e14f671852f). One PDF is counted as the available data-bearing artifact, not as a separate participant-data deposit or a claim that the publisher has no other files. Table 13 (p. 21) contains 24 group-project rows: W01/Exp through W12/Exp and W13/Ctrl through W24/Ctrl. Rows and column headings were confirmed from PDF text and PyMuPDF find_tables with text strategies. The arm is encoded in Work_ID; has_arm_assignment=true applies to projects, not identified students. Outcome values are aggregated expert ratings for projects; contents=aggregate_only is used because there are no participant IDs or project-to-student links, and the allowed schema has no category for output-level data without participant IDs. No individual questionnaire records, original/final expert rating matrix, plot data/code, raw designs, design statements, process summaries, or participant idea corpus are supplied. Table 7 (p. 15) gives arm-level questionnaire summaries only. In-article materials include the course outline (Figure 2, p. 7), rating rubric (Table 3, p. 12), questionnaire example items (Table 4, p. 13), and interview guides (Tables 5-6, p. 14). The PDF has no embedded files. The DOI and publisher landing page each returned HTTP 403, so any landing-page-only supplements could not be checked; their blocked response is not evidence of an account requirement.

notes: No public participant-level dataset was confirmed. The complete 1,000-line markdown conversion, including the end matter and references, was read; the 31-page article has no appendix. Its only explicit availability declaration is 'Data are contained within the article.' Other statements retained below identify in-article materials, data aggregation, software use, privacy, and data/software credits; they do not promise a released dataset or analysis code. No data repository, preregistration, code repository, separate supplementary-file link, or on-request offer was found, and both form.data_and_code URLs are empty. Table 12's 'Supplementary comparison' is an in-article analysis, and the 'supplementary course' on p. 11 is teaching supplied to the control group. Neither denotes a separate data file. No relevant external deposit was found through the four named APIs. Broad unquoted searches were refined rather than treated as exhaustive negative results; repeated identical queries are consolidated using confirmed response counts. OSF author-name searches are limited to node titles. The publisher landing page was inaccessible (HTTP 403), which limits confidence in ruling out a landing-page-only supplement. The direct, already-recorded publisher PDF was publicly accessible without credentials. Public Table 13 permits project-level means, SDs and nominal SEs by arm for the five rating dimensions and overall score, and confirms 12 scored projects per arm; independence cannot be checked without contributor/team mapping. These are not per-person estimates. None of final.open_items is resolved: distinct student contributors/team membership, initial versus consensus ratings used in Table 13/ICC, and Figure 6's scatter-point unit remain unknown. Therefore what_we_could_compute is null with respect to final.open_items. Student-level means/SDs/SEs, verified distinct-person analyzed counts for the rated outputs, and diversity of participants' texts/design ideas cannot be recovered from the confirmed public material.
